text_blocks.snippet: To apply for a Turkish e-visa online, you'll need to visit the official Republic of Turkey e-Visa website and fill out the application form with accurate information about your passport, travel details, and personal information. You'll also need to pay the e-visa fee online using a valid credit or debit card. After successful payment, you'll receive your e-visa via email.
snippet_highlighted_words: visit the official Republic of Turkey e-Visa website and fill out the application form with accurate information about your passport, travel details, and personal information

list.snippet: Visit the official Turkey e-Visa website: Go to the official Republic of Turkey e-Visa website (www.evisa.gov.tr).
Check eligibility and requirements: Ensure you meet the eligibility criteria for an e-visa based on your nationality and the purpose of your visit.
Fill out the application form: Provide accurate information about your passport, travel dates, and personal details, including your name, date of birth, and email address.
Upload necessary documents: Depending on your nationality and the type of visa, you may need to upload scanned copies of your passport and other supporting documents.
Make the payment: Pay the e-visa fee using a valid credit or debit card.
Receive your e-visa: After successful payment, your e-visa will be sent to the email address you provided in the application form.
Download and print: Download your e-visa and keep a digital or printed copy to present upon arrival in Turkey.
Ensure all information is accurate, as changes may not be possible after the visa is issued.
Apply at least 72 hours before your planned travel date, according to www.visaturkeys.org, to allow for processing time.
For nationalities not eligible for e-visa, or for purposes other than tourism or short-term business, you may need to apply through a Turkish embassy or consulate.
The e-visa is typically valid for tourism and short-term business travel.
If you exceed the allowed stay, you may need to obtain a residence permit.
